questions.question: What was brought into the temple at its dedication?
options: The idols of the conquered nations

questions.question: What filled the temple when the priests came out?
options: A blinding light shining down from the heavens
Smoke and the glory of the LORD (a cloud)
A deep and very sudden silence over all
A fire that came and consumed the offering
questions.answer: Smoke and the glory of the LORD (a cloud)

questions.question: Solomon prayed a long prayer of dedication, asking God to hear his people.
The priests brought the _____ of the covenant into the Most Holy Place.
A _____ filled the temple, for the glory of the LORD filled the house.
